source.quote: Valeura's working interest share production before royalties averaged 22,309 bbls/d, resulting in a total of 2.030 million barrels produced during Q2 2026, an increase of 4% over Q2 2025
Realised prices during Q2 2026 averaged US$105.8/bbl, a 56% increase over Q2 2025
Adjusted EBITDAX was US$162.8 million, adjusted cash flow from operations US$154.1 million, and free cash flow US$104.7 million
Cash increased to US$316.5 million (including US$15.8 million restricted cash), with no debt and adjusted net working capital of US$321.7 million
